The '''Hanofar system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the terrestrial<ref name="RES" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Hanofar]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|14|Hanofar}}</ref> Early during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="RES" /> Hanofar was held by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="CSWE" /> and was the site of protests against Imperial taxation which eventually grew violent and led to<ref name="RES" /> skirmishes with [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hanofar [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
